name: DizzyBot
description: DizzyBot is an extensible, self-hosted Discord music bot with YouTube, SoundCloud, internet radio, and optional Spotify support. This single container includes its private Lavalink audio node; no Compose stack, second container, exposed port, or manually managed Lavalink password is required.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent DizzyBot database and server settings.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Required token from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Optional. Spotify activates automatically when both Spotify credentials are provided.

variables.name: Spotify Client Secret
variables.description: Optional. Spotify activates automatically when both Spotify credentials are provided.

variables.name: Spotify Country Code
variables.description: Two-letter country code used for Spotify metadata.

variables.name: Radio Station Limit
variables.description: Maximum number of saved radio stations per Discord server.

variables.name: Allow Private Radio Streams
variables.description: Allow saved radio URLs to reach private or local network addresses. Enable only for a trusted server.

variables.name: Java Memory
variables.description: Memory options for the bundled Lavalink JVM.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used for the bot and Lavalink processes. The Unraid default is 99.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used for the bot and Lavalink processes. The Unraid default is 100.
